atoms.name: Separating hyperplane and margin of a point
Support vectors
atoms.one_line: Points with $y_i(w^\top x_i+b)=1$; deleting any other point changes nothing.

atoms.name: Dual and KKT
atoms.one_line: $w=\sum\alpha_i y_i x_i$, $\sum\alpha_i y_i=0$, $\alpha_i>0$ only on support vectors, $\sum\alpha_i=\|w\|^2$.

atoms.name: Soft margin and C
atoms.one_line: Add slack: $\tfrac12\|w\|^2+C\sum\xi_i$. Large $C$ approaches hard margin.

atoms.name: Kernels
atoms.one_line: $K(x,z)=\phi(x)^\top\phi(z)$; valid iff Gram matrices are PSD; sums and products of kernels are kernels.

patterns.name: Identify support vectors or count them
